title: Bloom
description: Hyperreal generative flowers in the spirit of Flume's album art — velvety parametric petals with cup, curl, ruffle and tapered tips, arranged in packed golden-angle spirals or flat whorls and unfurling on a slow bloom cycle. Pick a species — rose, dahlia, daisy, tulip, lily or poppy, or Assorted for a mixed bed — each with its own petal shape, colour character and flower centre (a florets disc, a dark poppy boss, long lily stamens, or a tucked rose heart). Every seed grows a different cultivar.
